correctness.rationale: Re-executed inputs/artifacts/census.py -> CENSUS OK and inputs/artifacts/verify.py -> ALL VERIFICATIONS PASSED (stdlib only, nonzero-exit on any mismatch). Independently checked: |Gi|=24,28,30,33,35,36 by BFS closure; |Sub|=30,28,12,4,4,60 with sorted subgroup-class-size lists summing to |Sub|; |Normal|=4,7,6,4,4,10; element-class sizes summing to |Gi| (S4 1+3+6+6+8=24; D28 1+1+6x2+7+7=28; S3xC5 5x1+5x2+5x3=30; C33 33x1; C35 35x1; S3xS3 1+2+2+3+3+4+6+6+9=36); derived orders [24,12,4,1],[28,7,1],[30,3,1],[33,1],[35,1],[36,9,1] with series reaching 1; centres 1,2,5,33,35,1; Sylow counts {2:3,3:4},{2:7,7:1},{2:3,3:1,5:1},{3:1,11:1},{5:1,7:1},{2:9,3:1}. Completeness argument valid: every H is join of its cyclic subgroups, least join-closed family from all cyclics is full lattice, plus asserted closure of every 1- and 2-subset present and per-subgroup closure/divisor checks; normality by full conjugation; classes as conjugation orbits with sum asserts; Hasse 66 covers re-checked minimal and single-witnessed with reachability==inclusion; normality-failure triple H=[0,1],g=elem2,gHg^-1=[0,5]!=H replays as subgroups; coset action on 4 left cosets of point-stabilizer S3 replays as homomorphism (24x24 checks) with kernel==core=={1}. Minor presentation slips (G36 compact '3x7' should be '3x8' to sum to 60; hasse sha256 string in research_report.json is 67 chars vs true 64-char hash; 'right-coset' header vs left-coset construction) do not alter verified artifact lists. Result is computational certificate, not theoretical proof, but honestly presented as machine-checked census.

originality.rationale: Compared substantively to nearest prior: Nash-Betz arXiv:2006.11315 (lower bounds + classification of abelian <=22 / non-abelian <=19 subgroups for OEIS A274847 - threshold classification, not six fixed presentations with normal counts/class equations/Hasse/coset replay); Fusari-Spiga arXiv:2304.14200 (asymptotic |Sub|<c|R|^(log2|R|/4) bound, not exact small-order tables); Lazorec arXiv:1901.06425 (beta=|L|/|G| ratio theory, not per-presentation census with derived lengths); Whitson 1978 ortholattice characterization (structural, not computational census). No cited source publishes the joint six-presentation package with full subgroup-class sizes, class equations, derived lengths plus S4 66-cover witnessed Hasse log and kernel==core coset replay. Components individually are textbook-derivable (S4 30 subgroups classical; D28 28=tau(14)+sigma(14); C33/C35 divisor lattices; S3xC5 12=6x2 by coprime direct product), and S3xS3 60 is routine Goursat/brute-force, but the exact joint certificate bundle as stated was not found in checked sources. Narrow novelty as a bundle therefore passes, without establishing priority by timestamp alone.

value.rationale: Even taking correctness and narrow novelty as given, the result is not independently worth finding later. It is a textbook restatement + mere parameter substitution + unexplained enumeration: S4 30 subgroups with 4 normals and 1+3+6+6+8 class equation is classical textbook knowledge (DRAFT Sec.5 admits this); D28 counts follow from textbook tau+sigma formula; C33/C35 4-subgroup divisor lattices are trivial exercises; S3xC5 12 subgroups / 6 normals follow immediately from coprime direct-product decomposition (6x2); S3xS3 60-subgroup lattice is a seconds-scale brute-force/GAP exercise with no new structure, conjecture, or method advance. Hasse log, normality-failure triple, and coset-action table are automatically generated consequences of the same brute force, not independent insights. Orders were chosen as a fixed parametric sweep (24,28,30,33,35,36) contrasting cyclic/dihedral/product cases without motivating a question that needs this joint table; nilpotency/solvability verdicts use standard Sylow-uniqueness and derived-series-to-1 checks. Reusable route is 'brute-force generator closure sized to tiny orders' with no complexity claim. Prior SCOPE-FAIL-20260907-014 was REJECTed on value for a larger extremal census over 231 groups of order 96; a fortiori a six-tiny-group census with two trivial cyclic cases fails the value gate. Fallback to orders 24,30,36 does not repair this.
